thread:
mike-sales: HelixCare (EU-based) just asked for SOC2 + ISO27001 artifacts, a penetration-attestation letter, and an explicit data residency statement showing EU-only storage for POC. They also want a short pricing note for Dedicated nodes vs Hosted for the trial. Can we turn this around in 4 business days? cc @yasmin-se @nora-sec

yasmin-se: EU-only storage for POC is fine via a region restriction and no cross-region replication. We'll need to run the POC in eu-west-1 (or their preferred EU region). That will affect latency testing.

nora-sec: We can produce SOC2 control mapping and ISO scope. For the data residency statement we can provide our regional deployment topology and a signed statement that the tenant and object storage are confined to EU regions for the POC. If they need contractual data residency guarantees we should route to Legal for a DPA addendum.

dan-ops: Ops note: spinning up a Dedicated small pool in eu-west-1 has a 7-10 business day lead time; Hosted in-region is immediate. Presigned S3 upload path in the EU is quick; infra can create s3://redwood-evidence-eu/helix-poc-<id> with lifecycle.

claire-legal: We can draft a SOC2 bridge letter and pen-test attestation. For data residency: happy to draft a DPA addendum if customer insists on contractual language. Also: if helix requests raw exploit traces or screenshots with internal hostnames we need an NDA addendum and will sanitize.

helix-contact: Hi team 6#x2014; thanks. We prefer presigned upload (EU region) and need the DPA addendum if you can do it within the POC window. Also can you provide an engineered delta on cost for a small Dedicated pool for evaluation?

yasmin-se: Quick cost delta: Hosted POC = baseline; Dedicated small pool (2x GPU equiv) in EU estimated +€Zk/mo and one-time provisioning fee. I'll make a concise delta doc. If they want private VPC + peering that adds integration hours.

nora-sec: For artifacts I can prepare: SOC2 control mapping (redwood controls -> CC categories), ISO27001 scope statement, sanitized network diagram (no internal hostnames/ips), and a short operations excerpt for key rotation. I need Helix to provide a redaction checklist for any sample logs they don't want shared.

dan-ops: For presigned S3 in the EU, here's a sample snippet we give customers (TTL 48h):
```python
import boto3
s3 = boto3.client('s3', region_name='eu-west-1')
post = s3.generate_presigned_post('redwood-evidence-eu', 'helix-poc/upload-2026.zip', ExpiresIn=172800)
print(post)
```
We enforce SSE and block public ACLs. We'll create a lifecycle rule to auto-delete after 7 days unless Helix requests otherwise.

infra-bot: Created path: s3://redwood-evidence-eu/helix-poc-1755559999, presigned TTL=48h, lifecycle=7d, SSE=AES256 enforced. Ticket EVID-EU-771 created.

claire-legal: I'll draft the pen-test attestation language including a redaction appendix option and a DPA addendum template. Also confirm whether Helix requires a SOC2 bridge covering the last 90 days.

helix-contact: We'd like the SOC2 bridge for the prior 90 days and the DPA addendum. Redaction checklist coming in 2h. Also: can you confirm you won't export keys outside EU? We need confirmation you use region-local KMS with customer-managed key option if requested.

nora-sec: We can confirm region-local KMS (AWS KMS in eu-west-1) for the POC. BYOK import is possible but requires coordination; we can provide a sanitized runbook for key rotation and KMS policies. For full BYOK import we'll need additional scheduling and an NDA addendum for console artifacts.

yasmin-se: Timeline recalc: infra needs ~6 business hours to provision the EU presigned path and ops hooks (done), security needs 1 business day to sanitize artifacts after receiving the redaction checklist, Legal needs 1 business day for DPA + attestation letters. Dedicated provisioning 7-10 business days if they choose that. So 4 business days for artifacts on Hosted looks feasible if Helix sends the redaction checklist now.

dan-ops: Action items: (1) Helix -> redaction checklist + manifest of files to upload (2) Nora -> sanitized SOC2/ISO docs + rotation excerpt (3) Claire -> DPA addendum + pen-test attestation + SOC2 bridge letter (4) Yasmin -> Dedicated vs Hosted delta pricing note (5) Infra -> presigned link (already created).

helix-contact: Sending redaction checklist now. Also: please include the small Dedicated delta; we'll evaluate but start POC on Hosted.

nora-sec: Received checklist. Starting redaction run on sample logs; I'll return a redacted PDF and a hashed-field variant for any PII. Expect sanitized artifacts by EOD +1 business day.

claire-legal: :white_check_mark: Drafting DPA addendum and pen-test attestation now, will drop here in ~8 hours for review.

yasmin-se: :white_check_mark: Pricing delta posted to our internal drive; will paste a short summary in the thread once Claire okays sharing numbers.

dan-ops: :white_check_mark: Presigned upload ready; waiting for manifest to issue tokens. Ticket EVID-EU-771 assigned to dan-ops.

mike-sales: Thanks team. Once the sanitized bundle and letters are in place I'll assemble and upload to the presigned path and loop Helix for review. If anything blocks, ping me directly.

infra-bot: Reminder: presigned tokens expire 48h after issuance; lifecycle will auto-delete objects after 7 days. For Dedicated requests, provisioning ETA is 7-10 business days in EU region.
